title: New Grad Summer Sprint: Onboarding Triage & Buddy Capacity
content:
Context:
This doc captures the triage from the July 6 onboarding sync and the ad-hoc buddy-capacity workshop. Goal: identify immediate blockers for the summer new-grad cohort (starting week of 7/13), reallocate buddy shifts, and surface hiring risks that could impact code reviews, rotation coverage, and sprint deliverables for Platform Engineering.

Attendees:
- Maya Chen (note-taker, onboarding lead)
- Arnav Gupta (backend buddy lead)
- Sofia Martinez (tech ramp coordinator)
- Ethan Park (SRE buddy)
- Priya Nair (hiring program manager)
- joined for 20m: Jonas Keller (Eng manager, product infra)

High-level summary:
- Cohort size: 12 new grads (7 backend, 3 infra, 2 infra/sre) starting 7/13.
- Current confirmed buddies: 9 volunteers. Gap = 3 buddy slots (especially backend).
- Primary risks: buddy burnout (Q3 on-call + mid-cycle releases), delayed laptop/KMS access for 4 hires, interviewing pipeline lag for 2 proposed additional headcount.
- Strong wins: updated onboarding checklist (PR merged), new short video on local devenv setup, auto-assign script for first-week pairing published.

Detailed notes / issues:
1) Buddy capacity and shift scheduling
   - Problem: Several senior engs have Q3 on-call rotations that overlap with planned intense onboarding weeks (7/13-8/7). If we assign full-day pairings, both buddies and new grads will get overloaded.
   - Proposal: adopt 2-tier shadowing: 2-hour deep pairing blocks + 1-hour async review time per day (max 3 pairing hours/day). Rotate pairings across team to spread knowledge.
   - Volunteer reshuffle: Arnav will take 2 extra backend pairings first week; Ethan will cover infra pairings. Need 1 more backend buddy or reduce pairing granularity for backend hires.
   - Action: Priya to ping eng managers by 7/8 for 2 more buddy volunteers.

2) Access & infra blockers
   - Status: 4 hires missing KMS access and VPN certs. This prevents local replication of service secrets and running integration tests.
   - Temporary workaround: provide short-lived test keys and a guided session on mocked secrets.
   - Owner: Sofia to coordinate with infra ops. Target resolution by 7/10.

3) Onboarding schedule & curriculum adjustments
   - Curriculum trimmed: replaced deep-dive kernel optimizations session from week 1 to week 3 to reduce cognitive load. Week 1 now focuses on: repo layout, local dev flow, test harness, code review expectations, and minimal infra ops runbook.
   - New micro-tasks (day 1-5): hello-world PR, run unit tests, merge a tiny docs fix, shadow a paging incident postmortem review. These are intentionally small to build confidence.
   - Additions: recorded 10-min walkthrough for the KV cache dev workflow (link in linked_artifacts).

4) Interview debrief pipeline (open roles & shadow hires)
   - Two candidates in final loop for backend SWE-2; both have conflicting offer windows next week. Feedback: strong infra fundamentals, one has weaker PR mentorship examples.
   - Interviewer calibration note: we observed variance in how "mentorship" is probed. Suggest adding a standardized mentorship behavioral question to final loop.
   - Action: Priya to update candidate rubric by 7/9 and request hiring committee exception if offers need to be accelerated.

5) Team health signals & metrics to watch
   - Short-term indicators: number of 1:1s canceled, review turnaround time for new-grad PRs, on-call overrides, reported pairing satisfaction (quick survey at end of week 1).
   - Baseline targets: PR review < 18 hours for onboarding PRs; < 2x escalation pages caused by new-grad changes in first 30 days.
   - Survey plan: 5-question pulse on day 5 and day 30. Sofia to draft survey by 7/9.

6) Contingency plans
   - If buddy gaps persist: slow down cohort ramp (reduce scope of first sprint), add rotational "office hours" with multiple buddies per slot instead of 1:1 pairing.
   - If access delays > 7/10: move those hires to remote-shadow track for first 2 weeks (observation + documentation tasks).

Decisions made:
- Move kernel-optimization deep-dive to week 3. (decision owner: Maya)
- Adopt 2-hour pairing blocks + async review model for week 1. (owner: Arnav)
- Implement day-5 pulse survey for cohort feedback. (owner: Sofia)

Open questions / unresolved:
- Can Recruiting expedite 2 candidate offers? (Priya to follow up with hiring leadership)
- Are there capacity credits (extra pairing hours) available from adjacent teams for week 1? (Jonas to check cross-team volunteers)
- Should we document a formal "buddy-exit" checklist for mid-week drops? (Maya to draft)

Action items (owners and dates):
- Priya: Ping managers for 2 buddy volunteers by 2026-07-08 (open).
- Sofia: Resolve KMS/VPN access for 4 hires by 2026-07-10 (in progress).
- Arnav: Publish pairing schedule and time-boxed pairing template by 2026-07-09 (in progress).
- Maya: Draft buddy-exit checklist and share in #eng-onboarding channel by 2026-07-11 (todo).
- Priya: Update candidate rubric with mentorship question by 2026-07-09 (todo).
- Sofia: Draft day-5 pulse survey by 2026-07-09 (todo).

Quick wins to ship before cohort start:
- merge small devenv video into onboarding drive (done)
- enable mocked-secrets runbook and small scripts for hires who lack KMS (target 7/09)
- push pairing auto-assigner fix to production (PR merged, minor follow-up)

Notes to self / loose ideas:
- Consider light-weight "pairing credits" ledger (microstamps) so managers can see how many buddy-hours each volunteer has given across cohorts. Could be a simple sheet initially.
- Explore a short permanent rotation where one senior engineer has weekly 2-hour dedicated onboarding office hours to reduce scheduling friction.

Appendix (links and references):
- Confluence playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/New+Grad+Onboarding+Playbook
- Onboarding checklist PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding-scripts/pull/142
- JIRA items: JIRA-ENG-4123 (KMS access), HIRE-78 (candidate offers)

End of notes.

Document history: created 2026-07-07; triage sync 2026-07-06; last edited 2026-07-10 (Maya).
